notes.title: Bug fixes and Quality of Life Improvements
notes.notes:
Bug fixes and Quality of Life Improvements
Game experience has been improved

We’re excited to bring you updates that enhance the overall game experience and add more engaging features!

What's New:  More Music Content: Added additional music to make gameplay more enjoyable and immersive. Enhanced Multiple Answer Games: You can now click on shapes in games with multiple answer options, providing a more interactive experience. New Achievement – "Artists": Unlocked when using the whiteboard, encouraging creativity and engagement. 

Bug Fixes:  Square vs Rectangle Bug: Resolved an issue in the Geometry game where squares and rectangles were not differentiated correctly. 

Enjoy the updated experience, and thank you for your feedback! Keep playing and watch for more improvements in future updates.

notes.notes: Multiple performance improvements has been applied.
